package.name: circular_formation
package.description: Decentralised circular formation control for differential-drive robots (TurtleBot3 Burger) in ROS 2 Jazzy + Gazebo Harmonic. Control-law modules are pure Python and runnable without ROS; ROS nodes, launch, world and RViz config are layered on top. Spawn and bridge conventions adapted from NSKsim (MIT, Ali Alhasan).
